instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pristine multi-page React router application with responsive navigation across all required routes: Home, About, Services (all 7 service sub-pages), Industries, Courses/Training, Study Abroad, Projects/Portfolio, and Contact.

Strictly honor the user's color palette: Deep Blue (#0B2345) as dominant corporate anchor, Energy Orange (#FF8A32) as kinetic action trigger, and crisp light background (#F8FAFC, #FFFFFF) for high readability.

Do NOT fabricate client testimonials, specific unverified client case studies, guaranteed study abroad visa claims, or fake partner logos. Keep portfolio as a structured capabilities showcase framework.

Implement the Contact & Inquiry form capturing: Full Name, Organization/Institution, Email, Phone Number, Service of Interest (Select dropdown with the 7 verticals), and Message. Provide instant feedback using Sonner toasts and mock inquiry submission store.
Support quick Course Inquiry and Study Abroad Advisory modal dialogues with contextual pre-selection of courses/destinations.
Ensure every interactive element has kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g. data-testid='contact-form-submit-button', data-testid='nav-services-link', data-testid='service-card-cybersecurity').
Ensure perfect mobile navigation with a polished slide-over Sheet component and sticky desktop navigation with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop: do not create generic flat centered layouts or default purple gradients. Use bold typography hierarchy (Outfit for headings, DM Sans for text) and intentional asymmetrical bento grids.
Never use pure black #000000; use #0B2345 (Deep Blue) or #07162C (Dark Navy) with subtle 1px border strokes #E2E8F0.
Use generous padding (py-16, py-24, gap-8) to give every section breathing room.
Include high-contrast hover states (e.g. hover:bg-[#E66D15] on accent buttons, hover:text-[#FF8A32] on dark links).
Never center align the root application container. Maintain natural left-aligned reading rhythm.
